title: GET a resource over HTTP
summary: Hit a real local HTTP handler and assert the JSON body.
description: The smallest useful integration test: start the Express app, issue GET /items/1, and check status plus payload. Compare Supertest, Playwright request, and pytest + httpx.

variants.label: Playwright
variants.notes: Uses Playwright's APIRequest context only — no browser is launched.

variants.label: pytest + httpx
variants.notes: Spawns samples/js-api/scripts/serve-ephemeral.mjs so httpx talks to the same Express app.
